pattern: O + 不/没 + 被/叫/让 + S + V
title: O + 不/没 + 被/叫/让 + S + V (O is not V’ed by S)
shortExplanation: O is not V’ed by S
longExplanation: O is not V’ed by S. Pinyin: O + bù/ méi + bèi/ jiào/ ràng + S + V
formation: O + bù/ méi + bèi/ jiào/ ràng + S + V

examples.romanization: wèntí hái méiyǒu bèi jiějué ne。
examples.translation: The problem has not been solved yet.

examples.sentence: 只有写完作业，才能看电视。
examples.romanization: zhǐyǒu xiěwán zuòyè， cáinéng kàn diànshì。
examples.translation: You can watch TV only if you finish your homework.

title: 不仅……也/还/而且…… (Not only… but also…)
longExplanation: Not only… but also…. Pinyin: bùjǐn…… yě/ hái/ érqiě……

examples.sentence: 我不仅看过《泰坦尼克号》，也看过《诺丁山》。
examples.romanization: wǒ bùjǐn kàn guò《 Tàitǎnníkè Hào》， yě kàn guò《 nuò dīng shān》。
examples.translation: I have not only seen Titanic, but also Notting Hill.

title: 不仅 S1……，S2 也…… (Not only S1…, S2 also…)
longExplanation: Not only S1…, S2 also…. Pinyin: bùjǐn S1……，S2 yě……

examples.sentence: 不仅马克看过《诺丁山》，我也看过《诺丁山》。
examples.romanization: bùjǐn Mǎkè kàn guò《 nuò dīng shān》， wǒ yě kàn guò《 nuò dīng shān》。
examples.translation: Not only did Mark see Notting Hill, I also saw Notting Hill.

title: 从来没 V/A 过 (never have V’ed, never have been A)
shortExplanation: never have V’ed, never have been A
longExplanation: never have V’ed, never have been A. Pinyin: cóngláiméi V/A guò

examples.sentence: 他爸爸妈妈从来没这么高兴过。
examples.romanization: tā bàba māma cóngláiméi zhème gāoxìng guò。
examples.translation: His father and mother have never been so happy.

title: 刚/刚刚 V (just V’ed)
longExplanation: just V’ed. Pinyin: gāng/ gānggang V

examples.translation: I just got married last month.

title: 刚 + V + DURATION (have V’ed for just DURATION)
longExplanation: have V’ed for just DURATION. Pinyin: gāng + V + DURATION

examples.romanization: tā gāng lái yī gè yuè。
examples.translation: He’s been [lit. come] here for just a month.

examples.sentence: 刚才我收到了一封电子邮件。
examples.romanization: gāngcái wǒ shōu dàoliǎo yī fēng diànzǐyóujiàn。

title: 即使……也…… (even if…, still…)
longExplanation: even if…, still…. Pinyin: jíshǐ…… yě……

examples.sentence: 即使冬天很冷，他也每天去操场跑步。
examples.romanization: jíshǐ dōngtiān hěn lěng， tā yě měitiān qù cāochǎng pǎobù。
examples.translation: Even if it’s very cold in winter, he still goes to the playground to job every day.

title: (在) N 上 (with regard to N)
longExplanation: with regard to N. Pinyin: ( zài) N shàng

examples.sentence: 在爱好上，我更像我妈妈。
examples.romanization: zài àihào shàng， wǒ gèng xiàng wǒ māma。
examples.translation: In terms of hobbies, I am more like my mother.
The clothes are just the right size.

title: V 得正好 (V’ed at just the right time)
shortExplanation: V’ed at just the right time
longExplanation: V’ed at just the right time. Pinyin: V dé zhènghǎo

examples.translation: You came at just the right time.

title: N & N 差不多 (N & N are about the same)
shortExplanation: N & N are about the same
longExplanation: N & N are about the same. Pinyin: N & N chàbuduō

examples.sentence: 这辆车的颜色和那辆车的颜色差不多。
examples.romanization: zhè liàng chē de yánsè hé nà liàng chē de yánsè chàbuduō。
examples.translation: The color of this car is similar to the color of that car.
